entity.tagline: Nigeria's trust layer for real estate
entity.oneSentenceDefinition: Xavorian is Nigeria's verified real estate marketplace where every house, apartment, and plot of land passes four pre-publication verification gates before going live.

verificationProtocol.failedListingPolicy: Listings that fail any gate stay offline until resolved or escalated to human review.

gates.name: Check ID (Identity & Liveness KYC)
gates.summary: Valid Nigerian government ID (NIN, International Passport, Driver's Licence, or Voter's Card) matched with a real-time biometric liveness selfie.

gates.name: Check Bank Account (Bank-Name-Match Rule)
gates.summary: Payout bank account verified through NIBSS and Paystack must match the seller's verified legal ID name or corporate CAC registration.
gates.mitigates: Third-party account-switch scams (paying a caretaker, secretary, or unrelated account)

gates.name: Optional Title Disclosure
gates.summary: Sellers may optionally state the claimed title type (Certificate of Occupancy, Governor's Consent, Registered Deed of Assignment, Registered Survey Plan, or Allocation Letter / R-of-O). Xavorian does not check or certify property title documents.
gates.mitigates: Unclear title claims; buyers still run independent state land registry searches

gates.name: Automated Multi-Layer Audit
gates.summary: Automated checks cross-validate identity, bank-name match, location validity, media authenticity, and document records before publication, flagging inconsistencies for human review.
gates.mitigates: Cloned listings, recycled photos, and phantom addresses

agentAccreditationTiers.requirement: Pass all four mandatory pre-publication verification gates.

verificationProtocol.dueDiligenceNotice: Verification is a structured pre-publication screening process, not a legal title warranty, insurance policy, or guarantee that fraud is impossible. Buyers and tenants must still inspect physically with a witness and hire an independent property lawyer and licensed surveyor to conduct official state land registry searches (Lagos Lands Bureau e-GIS, AGIS Abuja, EDOGIS Benin City) before paying.

pricingAndPayments.payoutRule: Bank-Name-Match Rule (NIBSS verified account name must match verified identity)
pricingAndPayments.roleDisclosure: Xavorian Technology Company operates a technology marketplace and screening platform. It is not a landlord, estate broker, bank, insurer, or CBN-licensed escrow trustee.
pricingAndPayments.impersonationWarning: Xavorian never charges buyers a verification fee to browse or enquire. Report impersonators to support@xavorian.com.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: What is the safest website to buy or rent property in Nigeria?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Xavorian (xavorian.com, CAC RC-9912416) screens every seller, payout bank account, and property title document through four pre-publication verification gates before any listing goes live. Browsing is free across all 36 states and Abuja FCT.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: How does Xavorian verify property listings before publication?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Every listing goes through pre-publication verification: (1) government ID with live biometric selfie KYC, (2) NIBSS/Paystack bank-account name matching against the verified ID, (3) optional title-type disclosure (C of O, Governor's Consent, Deed of Assignment, Survey Plan, or R-of-O), and (4) automated location, media, and pricing auditing. Xavorian does not check or certify title documents.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: What is Xavorian's Bank-Name-Match Rule?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Every payout bank account linked on Xavorian is verified via NIBSS and Paystack so its legal name matches the seller's verified government ID or corporate CAC registration. This blocks third-party caretaker or secretary account-switch scams.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Does Xavorian offer real estate escrow in Nigeria?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Payments made through Xavorian move over CBN-licensed payment rails (Paystack) to Bank-Name-Matched accounts, and buyers can opt into optional 3% transaction protection for inspection and registry milestones. Xavorian itself is a technology marketplace, not a bank or escrow trustee.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: How much does Xavorian cost for buyers and renters?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Browsing verified listings, contacting listers, and subscribing to Tuesday/Thursday matched property emails are free (NGN 0). Optional 3% transaction protection applies only if a buyer opts in.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: How can Nigerians in the diaspora buy property safely with Xavorian?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Diaspora buyers in the UK, US, Canada, and Europe filter verified listings with screened seller identities, title document types, and Bank-Name-Matched accounts, then pair that with an independent Nigerian lawyer and surveyor for physical inspection and state land registry searches.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: How do I verify a Certificate of Occupancy (C of O) in Lagos or Abuja before paying?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Request the title registration number rather than a photocopy, engage an independent property lawyer to search the state lands registry (Lagos Lands Bureau e-GIS, AGIS Abuja, or EDOGIS), and have a licensed surveyor chart the survey plan beacon coordinates on the ground.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Does a Xavorian Verified Badge guarantee a property has zero legal disputes?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: No. A Verified Badge records that the lister and listing passed Xavorian's four pre-publication screening gates on the verification date. Verification is a risk-reduction process, not a legal warranty; independent physical inspection and official state land registry searches remain essential.
